extracted.name: Overnight Refrigerator Oatmeal
extracted.description: Refrigerator oatmeal is prepared at night, refrigerated, and ready to eat in the morning for a portable breakfast. Add your favorite fruit or nuts!
instruction_lines: Stir oats, yogurt, and almond milk together in a jar with a lid. Twist lid onto jar and refrigerate, 8 hours to overnight. Stir oatmeal and add banana when ready to eat.
